title: Ryan Poles: Caleb Williams has work to do, but we have to plan for eventual extension

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ryan Poles: Caleb Williams has work to do, but we have to plan for eventual extension
sources.description: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams can't sign a contract extension until the 2027 offseason, but thoughts about it are already part of the long-term planning in Chicago.
